q: What is DEI x VLABS Hackathon '26?
a: A national student hackathon organised by Dayalbagh Educational Institute (DEI), Agra, and Virtual Labs, an MoE Govt of India initiative. Teams build working prototypes of next-generation virtual laboratory experiments.
Engineering and science students enrolled in UG, PG or Diploma programmes.

q: What do teams need to submit?
a: A presentation made with the official PPT template and a working MVP (Minimum Viable Product) or prototype.

Registration starts on 18 January. The submission deadline is 30 January. Shortlisted teams are announced on 2 February. The offline final round is on 7 February at Dayalbagh Educational Institute, Agra.

q: How many teams reach the final round?
a: 10 teams are shortlisted for the offline final round at Dayalbagh Educational Institute, Agra.
Innovation and creativity (30%), technical complexity (30%), UX and interactivity (25%), and alignment to the theme (15%).
Each student in the top 3 teams gets an internship at Virtual Labs (MoE, India) with a stipend of ₹15,000 per month. All shortlisted teams receive certificates.

q: Is accommodation provided for the final round?
a: Yes. Accommodation for the offline final round is provided by the college.

Virtual Labs is an initiative of the Ministry of Education (MoE), Govt of India, under the National Mission on Education through ICT. It gives students remote access to science and engineering lab experiments.
